title: Implement XDG_CONFIG_HOME for ~/.claude.json
body: Currently it seems there's no way to change where the `.claude.json` lives. It would be great if it could be loaded from `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/claude/claude.json` according to the [XDG Base Directory Specification](https://specifications.freedesktop.org/basedir-spec/latest/)
author: oatmealraisin
